_comment: Copy to cypress.env.json (gitignored) and fill in the real values.
baseUrl, an API origin and a test account. Only the accounts live here —
the URLs are public and stay committed in the TARGETS table.
dev needs nothing: its account is committed in environments.ts.
stg and main sign in to live deployments, so their accounts are required
here (or as CYPRESS_-prefixed CI secrets) and the run fails fast without.
Keys are read in this order, most specific first:
TEST_USER_EMAIL      overrides whichever environment is running
In CI set the same names with a CYPRESS_ prefix:
Defining all three pairs at once means one job runs any environment by
